name: Android Phone (Virtual)
description: A virtual Android phone, right beside you in VR.
author: josethevrtech
license: MIT (source); external assets retain their licenses
tagline: A little Android. A lot of possibility.
about: Android Phone (Virtual) keeps everyday apps within reach: notes, calendar, clock, calculator, files, gallery, music, podcasts, radio, video and a web browser. Its own Apps & media page opens streaming services, app stores and Google web apps. First setup downloads about 214 MB. Some apps require sign-in; Google Play Services and DRM are not provided, and service compatibility varies. Pick up the phone or return it to the shelf. Off stops Android and its audio; installed apps and data remain for next time.
